market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1–3 month window as RBA rate-hike expectations, falling house prices, and construction-sector stress weigh on sentiment. Rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, construction, property) face the most downside. Gold, gas, and rare earths offer relative strength. US NFP data and DXY weakness may provide a brief AUD-supported rally.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if the RBA pivots after the current tightening cycle. The 'bull case returns' narrative and AI capex cycle (Nvidia) support global equities. However, Australia's stalling per-capita growth vs. Canada, housing correction, and energy transition cost overhang cap upside. Structural winners: critical minerals, gas, healthcare (GLP-1 shift), and quality financials on a credit-cycle reset.
